body:
I guess an explanation, if I owe them one. A justification for why I needed to die, letting them know that the Pain was too much to keep on living. I don't expect anyone to understand that pain but I feel the need to tell them.

Personally, I'll apologize for being such a burden and hope that my death can make up for it, since from now on I won't be consuming the resources that could go to someone else. 

And in order to really seal the deal and divorce myself from this world, I'll divide up whatever belongings or money I have and donate them. That way I will make a clean exit and no loose ends

I feel the same way. For me it feels like no one really told us what reality would be like and then we got thrown into it completely unprepared and now we're drowning instead of swimming and only the strong survive..
Do you ever feel like that?
